sloka: अन्तपालाश्च यास्यन्ति सदारो यत्र राघवः ।सहोपजीव्यम् राष्ट्रम् च पुरम् च सपरिच्छदम् ॥२-३७-२६॥
transliteration: antapālāśca yāsyanti sadāro yatra rāghavaḥ ।sahopajīvyam rāṣṭram ca puram ca saparicchadam ॥2-37-26॥

translations.english: The guardians of the harem, its patron king Dasaratha with his retinue and, the people of this city will go wherever Rama lives with his wife.
